He first showed up in ''Minccino—Neat and Tidy!'' when Bianca attempted to use him to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{TP|Bianca|Minccino}} that had stolen the dirty Badge case that she had given to {{Ash}}. He fought with an impressive {{m|Flame Charge}} attack but Minccino managed to escape it. Though he had overwhelming power, he was taken down by Minccino with a combination of {{m|Hyper Voice}} and {{m|Tickle}}. [[File:BW049.png|thumb|left|250px|Pignite battling Zebstrika]] Bianca later used Pignite to battle [[Ash's Pikachu]]. He managed to catch Pikachu off guard by rushing towards him with {{m|Take Down}} followed by a powerful {{m|Heat Crash}} attack. Despite him gaining the upper hand at first, the Fire Pig Pokémon was taken down by a single {{m|Volt Tackle}} from Pikachu. Bianca used Pignite to help track down an {{p|Emolga}} that she wanted to catch in ''[[BW024|Emolga the Irresistible!]].'' Unfortunately, he ended up making a wild {{p|Scolipede}} angry when he attacked it with {{m|Flamethrower}}. She used him again in ''[[BW025|Emolga and the New Volt Switch!]]'' where he battled [[Iris's Emolga]], who [[Infatuation|infatuated]] him with {{m|Attract}}. Later when Emolga brought out [[Ash's Snivy]] with {{m|Volt Switch}} he continued his battle against her instead. He struggled in the battle despite having a type advantage, but the winner of the battle was not seen. In ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', Bianca offered to trade Pignite for [[Luke's Zorua]], but later changed her mind, after he declined anyway. Bianca used Pignite in her battle against [[Elesa]] in ''[[BW049|Enter Elesa, Electrifying Gym Leader!]]''. Her two other Pokémon had been knocked out by her {{p|Zebstrika}} and he was her last hope of winning. Though he outlasted his teammates, Pignite eventually fell to Zebstrika which resulted in a loss for Bianca. [[File:Bianca Emboar vs Trip Conkeldurr.png|thumb|right|250px|Emboar struggling to break through Conkeldurr's defenses]] In ''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]'', it was revealed that Pignite had [[Evolution|evolved]] into Emboar sometime before the [[Clubsplosion]]. He began a battle against [[Trip]] and his {{p|Conkeldurr}} in the first round. Demonstrating his new capabilities, {{m|Arm Thrust}} and {{m|Hammer Arm}}, Emboar fought hard, but was unable to break through Conkeldurr's defenses. He was soon smashed into the ground, after Conkeldurr attacked him with a {{m|Bulk Up}} powered {{m|Strength}}, and then trapped by {{m|Rock Tomb}}. Emboar attempted to use Arm Thrust to destroy the rocks surrounding him but grew tired, just as his opponent launched a {{m|Stone Edge}} attack. [[File:Bianca and Emboar.png|thumb|left|250px|Emboar and Bianca]] In ''[[BW072|A Clubsplosion of Excitement!]]'', Emboar was shown to have caught Conkeldurr's Stone Edge then used {{m|Fling}} to send them back at it. While Conkeldurr was blocking the stones with its concrete pillars, Emboar got closer, snatched the pillars, and used Fling to hurl them at Conkeldurr, defeating the Muscular Pokémon and allowing Bianca to proceed to the next round of the tournament. Later in the second round, Emboar faced [[Georgia]]'s {{p|Bisharp}}. He started the battle with Flamethrower before Georgia could finish her lecture. Flamethrower did a lot of damage to the {{type|Steel}} Pokémon. He collided with Bisharp's {{m|Guillotine}} attack with Hammer Arm and after enduring a {{m|Metal Sound}}-{{m|Iron Head}} combo, Emboar won the match with a second Flamethrower. In ''[[BW073|Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!]]'', Emboar faced off against [[Stephan's Sawk]]. After Emboar missed with a Hammer Arm attack, he was hit hard by a {{m|Bulk Up}} powered {{m|Karate Chop}}. Emboar's attacks continued to prove too slow for Sawk's speedy movements and he was defeated by a Bulk Up powered {{m|Close Combat}} attack and a double Karate Chop, eliminating him and Bianca from the tournament. Emboar was sent out to battle against [[Mikael]]'s {{p|Watchog}} in the first round of the [[Vertress Conference]] in ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', and was able to easily defeat the {{type|Normal}} Pokémon. In [[BW104|the second round]], Emboar was the second Pokémon Bianca sent out to face {{un|Cameron}}'s {{p|Samurott}} in her two on two battle against him. Despite the type-disadvantage, Emboar was able to withstand an {{m|Aqua Jet}} attack and a {{m|Hydro Cannon}} before infatuating Samurott with Attract. Emboar then easily beat Samurott with a rapid Arm Thrust and a powerful Hammer Arm. Emboar then had to face [[Cameron's Riolu]]. He started with an Arm Thrust attack, however Riolu dodged it and when Emboar attempted a Hammer Arm, Riolu countered with {{m|Circle Throw}}. Emboar stood up, only to be knocked down by multiple {{m|Force Palm}} attacks. He then grabbed the much smaller Riolu and threw it across the battle field, although Riolu was able to recover and land on its feet. Emboar then used Flamethrower, only for it to be dodged and then used back at him through the use of Riolu's {{m|Copycat}}. Emboar was finally knocked out by {{m|Vacuum Wave}}; eliminating Bianca from the Vertress Conference. ===Personality and characteristics=== Initially, Emboar, as a Pignite, mirrored Bianca's own temperamental nature, often sulking or throwing fits when his attacks missed, as seen in ''[[BW013|Minccino—Neat and Tidy!]]''. However, since evolving, he has matured significantly. He now displays pride in his strength, is obedient to Bianca, and handles damage and defeats with a calm demeanor, much like Bianca's growth throughout her journey. He also shares Bianca's clumsiness, evidenced in ''[[BW071|Search for the Clubultimate!]]'' where he unsuccessfully tried to prevent her from falling after she tripped. Furthermore, he's proven to be incredibly resilient, enduring two super-effective attacks—Hydro Cannon and Aqua Jet—from Cameron's Samurott and continuing to battle. ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{fire color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{fire color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{fighting color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a Pignite |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Bianca Pignite.png|250px]] |} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|fire|fighting|Bianca Pignite {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Tackle|1=Flame Charge|2=Heat Crash|3=Take Down|4=Flamethrower}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Tackle|1=Flame Charge|2=Heat Crash|3=Take Down|4=Flamethrower}}

Pignite was given to Bianca when it was only a {{p|Tepig}} by Professor Juniper. When [[Team Plasma]] stole a little girl's {{p|Minccino}}, claiming to be liberating it, Bianca worried at the thought of being separated from her Pignite, revealing it to have evolved. Later at [[Dragonspiral Tower]], she sent Pignite out to battle the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s that prevented her, [[Cheren]], and [[Brycen]] from getting to [[N]]. {{-}} ==References== ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo2|Tepig|Pignite|Emboar}} {{Bianca's Pokémon|fire|fighting}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Bianca's Pokémon|Emboar]] [[Category:Juniper's Pokémon|Emboar]] [[Category:Animation characters' first Pokémon|Emboar]] [[Category:Male characters (Pokémon)|Emboar]] [[de:Bells Flambirex]] [[es:Emboar de Bianca/Bel]] [[fr:Roitiflam de Bianca]] [[it:Emboar di Belle]] [[ja:ベルのエンブオー]]
